data.name: Kalavati
data.long_meaning: Kalavati is a name of the goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. The name Kalavati means 'Goddess of the universe'. She is often depicted as sitting on a lotus flower and holding a lotus in each of her four hands, symbolizing the abundance and prosperity she brings to the world.
data.spiritual_meaning: Kalavati represents the divine feminine energy and the abundance and prosperity that comes from tapping into that energy. She is a symbol of the nurturing and creative aspects of the divine, and is often invoked for blessings of wealth, prosperity, and fertility.
